name: uk.co.sisoco/gleif-lei-parent-company
title: Sisoco One LEI
description: No sign-up. LEI lookup and direct/ultimate parent companies (GLEIF), and LEI to UK/FR company.

tools.name: sisoco_check_company
tools.description: Start here. Resolves a UK company number, French SIREN, LEI, or a company name with country (GB or FR) to one company, and returns its identity, current signals (e.g. accounts overdue, insolvency notice, sanctions possible match for the company or its GLEIF direct and ultimate parents) and events of the last 90 days, each with its official source URL. A name that matches several companies returns error ambiguous_match with ranked candidates; call again with a candidate's number. Facts from official registers, never a score or a verdict; sanctions results are possible matches that need the user's own review. Cost: 1 lookup from the monthly quota (same as GET /v1/check). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company.description: Registry number (e.g. 00445790, SIREN 552032534), LEI, or a company name

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (GB, FR); needed for name searches

tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_parents
tools.description: Returns the direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents reported to GLEIF (Level 2) for a Legal Entity Identifier, each with its LEI and name, or the reason no parent is reported (e.g. NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON). Works for any country. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/entities/lei/{lei}/parents). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_record
tools.description: Returns the GLEIF record for a Legal Entity Identifier: legal name, registered and headquarters addresses, legal form, registration authority and number, entity and registration status (e.g. LAPSED). For its parent companies call sisoco_get_lei_parents. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/entities/lei/{lei}). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).
